mapper.sql: w.revocation_request_id, f.target_type, f.tenant_id, f.membership_id, f.identity_id, w.revocation_status, w.cursor_family_id, w.revoked_family_count, w.revoked_jti_count, w.attempt_count, w.next_attempt_at, w.lease_owner, w.lease_until, w.fencing_token, w.recovery_exhausted_at, w.last_failure, w.completed_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM iam_user_session_revocations w JOIN iam_revocation_fences f USING (revocation_request_id) WHERE w.revocation_request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_user_session_revocations (revocation_request_id, revocation_status, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, 'PENDING', #{at}) ON CONFLICT (revocation_request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH claimed AS ( UPDATE iam_user_session_revocations SET lease_owner = #{claimant}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, fencing_token = fencing_token + 1 WHERE revocation_request_id = #{requestId} AND revocation_status = 'PENDING' AND attempt_count < #{maximumAttempts} AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}) RETURNING revocation_request_id ) SELECT FROM claimed c JOIN iam_user_session_revocations w USING (revocation_request_id) JOIN iam_revocation_fences f USING (revocation_request_id)

WITH candidate AS ( SELECT revocation_request_id FROM iam_user_session_revocations WHERE revocation_status = 'PENDING' AND attempt_count < #{maximumAttempts} AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, revocation_request_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ), claimed AS ( UPDATE iam_user_session_revocations w SET lease_owner = #{claimant}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, attempt_count = w.attempt_count + 1, fencing_token = w.fencing_token + 1 FROM candidate c WHERE w.revocation_request_id = c.revocation_request_id RETURNING w.revocation_request_id ) SELECT FROM claimed c JOIN iam_user_session_revocations w USING (revocation_request_id) JOIN iam_revocation_fences f USING (revocation_request_id)

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT f.id AS family_id, (f.revoked_at IS NULL AND f.absolute_expires_at > #{at} AND ((#{targetType} = 'TENANT' AND f.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) OR (#{targetType} = 'MEMBERSHIP' AND f.membership_id = #{membershipId}) OR (#{targetType} = 'IDENTITY' AND f.identity_id = #{identityId}))) AS revoke_family FROM iam_refresh_token_families f WHERE (#{targetType} = 'IDENTITY' OR f.family_purpose = 'USER_TENANT') AND (#{cursor}::uuid IS NULL OR f.id > #{cursor}) AND ( (f.revoked_at IS NULL AND f.absolute_expires_at > #{at} AND ((#{targetType} = 'TENANT' AND f.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) OR (#{targetType} = 'MEMBERSHIP' AND f.membership_id = #{membershipId}) OR (#{targetType} = 'IDENTITY' AND f.identity_id = #{identityId}))) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_access_token_issuances x WHERE x.family_id = f.id AND x.revoked_at IS NULL AND x.expires_at + INTERVAL '30 seconds' > #{at} AND ((#{targetType} = 'TENANT' AND x.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) OR (#{targetType} = 'MEMBERSHIP' AND x.membership_id = #{membershipId}) OR (#{targetType} = 'IDENTITY' AND x.identity_id = #{identityId})) ) ) ORDER BY f.id LIMIT #{batchSize} ) SELECT c.family_id, c.revoke_family, i.jti, i.identity_id, i.membership_id, i.tenant_id, i.kid, i.issued_at, i.expires_at FROM candidates c LEFT JOIN iam_access_token_issuances i ON i.family_id = c.family_id AND i.revoked_at IS NULL AND i.expires_at + INTERVAL '30 seconds' > #{at} AND (c.revoke_family OR (#{targetType} = 'TENANT' AND i.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) OR (#{targetType} = 'MEMBERSHIP' AND i.membership_id = #{membershipId}) OR (#{targetType} = 'IDENTITY' AND i.identity_id = #{identityId})) ORDER BY c.family_id, i.jti
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_access_token_issuances SET revoked_at = #{at}, revocation_reason = 'TARGET_SESSION_REVOCATION' WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at + INTERVAL '30 seconds' > #{at} AND jti IN #{jti}

UPDATE iam_user_session_revocations SET cursor_family_id = COALESCE(#{cursor}, cursor_family_id), revoked_family_count = revoked_family_count + #{familyCount}, revoked_jti_count = revoked_jti_count + #{jtiCount}, revocation_status = CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN #{at} ELSE NULL END, attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = #{at}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_failure = NULL WHERE revocation_request_id = #{requestId} AND revocation_status = 'PENDING' AND fencing_token = #{fencingToken}

UPDATE iam_user_session_revocations SET revocation_status = 'PENDING', recovery_exhausted_at = NULL, last_failure = NULL, attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = #{at}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE revocation_request_id = #{requestId} AND revocation_status = 'RECOVERY_REQUIRED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM iam_user_session_fence_releases r JOIN iam_user_session_revocations w USING (revocation_request_id) JOIN iam_revocation_fences f USING (revocation_request_id) WHERE r.release_request_id = #{releaseRequestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_user_session_fence_releases (release_request_id, revocation_request_id, target_type, target_id, released_at) VALUES (#{releaseRequestId}, #{revocationRequestId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{at})
